result.excerpt:
The individual arming checks can be enabled or disabled as per:

.. code:: bash

    arm check X
    arm uncheck X
    
Where X can be: all, baro, compass, gps, ins, params, rc, voltage, battery, airspeed, 
logging, switch, gps_config, mission, rangefinder, system
